text:
[NCBK.1.7] **A callback runs on the stack of the `ds_engine_*` call that fires
it**, synchronously and on the caller's thread: a pump, an assert or retract, a
clock set. libds starts no thread to deliver one ([IARC.1.10]). Callbacks must
be non-blocking and thread-free; push real work onto a queue the runtime
services later ([NLFC.3]).
